name: What kind of paint finishes are available for interior walls?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint finishes are available for interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: A variety of paint finishes are available, each offering different aesthetics and durability. Common options include flat (matte), eggshell, satin, semi-gloss, and high-gloss. Flat finishes are good for low-traffic areas, while satin and semi-gloss are more durable and easier to clean, making them suitable for kitchens, bathrooms, and trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Available paint finishes include flat, eggshell, satin, semi-gloss, and high-gloss, each with varying durability and appearance.
